fills.primary_value: Tarbagatay Munay LLP (Kazakhstan); Xinjiang Guanhei Zimunai LNG Development LLC (China)
fills.researcher_notes: This is the primary source behind the wiki's own claim, independently re-verified rather than copied from the infobox. adilet.zan.kz/eng/docs/P1300000277 is the ratified Kazakhstan-China intergovernmental agreement (approved 27.03.2013, live per url_verifier -- insecure_tls, per Kazakhstan gotcha 1) and states in Article on organizations: '1) from the Kazakhstani side - \'Tarbagatay Munay\' Limited Liability Partnership, which is responsible for the section of the gas pipeline on the territory of the Republic of Kazakhstan (Kazakhstan organization); 2) from the Chinese side, Xinjiang Guanhei Zimunai LNG Development Limited Liability Company, which is responsible for the gas pipeline section in the territory of the People's Republic of China' -- i.e. it names each entity as operator of its OWN country's section, exactly the split the protocol asks researchers to establish. Independently corroborated by two Kazakh business-press pieces (kapital.kz and inbusiness.kz, both fetched directly and verified live) that both confirm TOO 'Tarbagatay Munay' as the Kazakh-side company responsible for construction; inbusiness.kz additionally traces its ultimate Chinese-side ownership to China ZhenHua Oil Co. Ltd. as a separate detail, not a name conflict with Xinjiang Guanhei Zimunai. tier=high: one primary intergovernmental legal source + two independent secondary press sources, none tracing to GEM or to each other.

validity.recommendation: Keep LengthKnownKm = 92.50 km; do not shorten it to match the drawn route. Flag the drawn route (currently 60 km) as the item needing attention -- it likely undercounts and could stand a re-draw, but I am not proposing new coordinates per protocol.
validity.researcher_notes: This is a case where Kazakhstan's usual 'no line-wise register' caveat does NOT apply -- a per-string spec genuinely exists in the primary planning document. Order of the Minister of Energy #350 (29.09.2023, adilet.zan.kz/rus/docs/G23JVM00350), paragraph 95, prose text (not a map appendix -- fetched and read directly, not just substring-matched): 'На территории Восточно-Казахстанской области реализован проект строительства магистрального газопровода \'Сарыбулак - Зимунай\' в направлении Китайской Народной Республики обшей протяженностью 92,5 км' (a trunk gas pipeline project 'Sarybulak-Zimunay' toward the PRC with a total length of 92.5 km has been realized in East Kazakhstan region) -- an EXACT match to the sheet's 92.50 km, from Kazakhstan's own government. This is also independently consistent with a 500 million m3/year (0.5 bcm/y) capacity figure reported by a 2013-era neftegaz.ru piece for the pipeline's design capacity, matching the sheet's existing 0.50 bcm/y (not proposing a new capacity fill since it wasn't flagged and the sheet already carries the right number). tier=medium for the length citation (one strong primary source; I could not find a second, independent line-specific length figure -- the two press pieces used for Operator above discuss the pipeline's history/companies but not its exact length). Given 92.5 km is well-sourced and the drawn route is only 60 km (65% of stated), the mismatch is very likely on the geometry side, consistent with the row's own RouteAccuracy='low'.
